method: Source inspection of the local main checkout. Product launch controls and diagnostics also have narrowly scoped runtime observations recorded separately below. No release-install or agent-execution validation was performed. Website browser checks are separate.

launch.scope: Current session wizard, workspace choices, model loading and launch controls

connection.scope: Hosted connection prerequisites, tab independence, switching versus forgetting and version warnings

settings.scope: Project directories and server settings labels

chat.scope: Chat labels, send and queue controls, interruption, visible session activity

diff.scope: Changes, Commits, comparisons, Code, bounded file previews and stale data

questions.scope: Questionnaire launch labels, queueing, submission target, delivery failure and deletion

review.scope: Review entry point, focus prompt, finding sections, comments and status checks

mobile.scope: Mobile interrupt control and scrollable workspace tabs

example.scope: Locally runnable sample and exact expected outputs; agent prose is illustrative

editorial.scope: Documentation navigation, feedback process and generated text exports

project-creation.scope: Project creation controls, configured roots, README and initial commit outcomes

permissions.scope: Initial enabled autonomy, provider labels, Codex permission mapping, Claude launch flag and Antigravity controls

session-signals.scope: Sidebar activity, idle, stopping, closing, unavailable transcript and separate delivery status

review-actions.scope: Triage versus dispatch, meanings of actions, context clearing and delivery failure

diff-comparisons.scope: Diff filters labels, comparison scopes and base resolution

closing.scope: Close controls, opt-in worktree deletion, blocked deletion and asynchronous cleanup notices

diagnostics.scope: Read-only status endpoint and serverVersion/protocolVersion response fields

file-access.scope: Server workspace paths from project/workspace controls; documented shell recipe checked locally in a disposable repository. Remote SSH authentication and operator handoff remain unexercised.

question-details.scope: Depth presets, generation status, captured context, answer message and instruction to proceed immediately after submission; questionnaires are illustrative.

context-actions.scope: Managed context reset, provider replacement and Claude terminal clear before review delivery; successful clear resets conversation history, not repository files.

approval-flow.scope: Codex request titles, available decision labels and submission card; Claude parsed options and terminal fallback. Source and Codex unit checks, not live approval execution.

review-scope.scope: Default origin/main review base with origin/master fallback; committed branch comparison; refinement versus rewriting and empty-panel states.

git-refresh.scope: Prompt bar branch refresh on web and native; loading and retry indicators in Diff.

runtimeObservations.scope: Read-only GET /api/status confirmed version fields. Walked New session → documentation project → Current checkout → Codex. Observed Full Auto checked and Start session available; captured only the provider panel at desktop and mobile widths. No session was started. This differs from the source revision; approval behavior and installation were not exercised.
runtimeObservations.method: Local HTTPS request and isolated browser with mutating API requests blocked.

captures.crop: Actual provider settings panel; surrounding projects and conversations excluded. No retouching.
